name: settings_check_bluetooth_status
intent: Check whether Bluetooth is turned on in the Settings app
description: Opens Settings, navigates through Connected devices and Connection preferences to the Bluetooth page, and reports the state of the Use Bluetooth switch.
patterns: is bluetooth turned on or off

steps.intent: Tap Connected devices to reach connectivity settings
Tap Connection preferences to reach Bluetooth settings
Tap Bluetooth to open its settings page and check the switch
